title: Cardona/Montserrat
text: An expensive trip but incredible sights and history. Our guide Ramon was very friendly and knowledgeable
author: A9362ONdeanw

title: Ask for Ramon as your guide!
text:
Highlight of our tour was our guide, Ramón! He was super knowledgeable, passionate about our tour locations, fun, and high energy! We took the Cardona tour specifically for my partner and his father to be able to visit their namesake. Ramon took special care and it was an unforgettable experience!
Highly, highly recommend!!
author: Kelly_B

title: Perfect excursion!
text: Fantastic experience, the Xavi guide was perfect!
author: 64valp

title: One of the BEST Tours!
text: Marcel was an amazing tour guide! The  castle had a beautiful interior and exterior with breathtaking views from the top! Loved Cardona’s streets, shops and their town square. The Salt Mountain tour was very informative. Opted to spend less time in Cardona and visited Montserrat monastery on the return. This tour will not disappoint!
author: 509melindaa

title: Great experience
text:
We had a relaxing and informative tour. Guide Ramon was excellent. He made sure we don’t get bored on the tour. Ramon was giving us enough time o explore places at our own pace and information about the history behind the place. 
At the end he did small quiz with my children and they loved it. Thank you for great experience!!
